This page lists the exact Glyphs MCP 2.0 callable surface. Input schemas
and enum values are published by MCP discovery; this table records stable
tool identity, effect, category, and intent.

| Tool | Effect | Category | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `get_server_info` | `read` | `server` | Read the v2 contract, permanent Python fallback, Knowledge version, host, and capabilities. |
| `list_documents` | `read` | `document` | List open Glyphs documents with stable process-local IDs. |
| `read_document` | `read` | `document` | Read canonical entities and computed observations through one selector and projection. |
| `evaluate_constraints` | `read` | `document` | Evaluate reusable field constraints without changing the document. |
| `preview_change` | `read` | `change` | Resolve exact targets and mechanically simulate generic operations into one immutable preview. |
| `apply_change` | `edit` | `change` | Apply one exact immutable preview through the verified transaction kernel without rerunning planning. |
| `get_operation` | `read` | `history` | Read one bounded operation or preview record. |
| `list_history` | `read` | `history` | List unsaved-session verified change commits. |
| `revert_change` | `edit` | `history` | Revert one compatible verified change without overwriting unrelated later edits. |
| `search_knowledge` | `read` | `knowledge` | Search the pinned offline font-design and Glyphs-coding corpus with citations and version filters. |
| `get_knowledge` | `read` | `knowledge` | Retrieve exact pinned Knowledge entries by stable ID. |
| `execute_python` | `code` | `python` | Permanent backup for read-only, staged-document, and live-open-world Glyphs tasks not covered by declarative operations. |
| `preview_export` | `read` | `export` | Create an immutable source-bundle export preview. |
| `apply_export` | `files` | `export` | Publish one exact reviewed source bundle. |
| `save_document` | `save` | `document` | Explicitly save or Save As with source and destination verification. |
| `open_document_view` | `ui` | `host` | Open exact glyphs in a Glyphs Edit tab without document mutation intent. |
| `get_runtime_status` | `read` | `runtime` | Read strict Python runtime-interlock health and recovery evidence. |
| `repair_runtime` | `code` | `runtime` | Repair manager-owned Python runtime-interlock state. |

## Surface invariants

- The catalog contains exactly 18 tools.
- Knowledge supplies cited evidence, skills supply font-design and
  Glyphs expertise, and tools supply generic mechanics.
- Every document mutation is previewed against exact identities and a
  source fingerprint. `apply_change` consumes the stored patch without
  rerunning planning or staged Python.
- `execute_python` is a permanent fallback with `read_only`,
  `staged_document`, and `live_open_world` modes.
- Knowledge is pinned and searched offline; updates occur only through
  reviewed deterministic builds.
- Saving, export publication, UI actions, runtime repair, and open-world
  Python remain explicit effect boundaries.
